records.title: Michigan State University International Merit Scholarships

validation.notes: Discovered by following the official_source_url (admissions.msu.edu) up to the university's own brand asset page. brand.msu.edu/downloads is on the official msu.edu domain and publishes the MSU wordmark. The asset itself is served from MSU's own Sitecore edge media delivery under /media/project/msu/shared/logos/ (the same shared/logos media path that admissions.msu.edu itself references for its own icon), and the file renders as the Spartan-green (#18453B) 'Michigan State University' wordmark with the green rule - not a favicon, not a department signature, not UI chrome. Fetched and read the SVG: vector artwork, viewBox 264.75 x 56.391, glyph paths filled #18453B plus '<rect y="29.805" fill="#18453B" width="264.266" height="1.786"/>'. The brand page component supplies alt="Michigan State University" and links to https://msu.edu, proving identity. Note: brand.msu.edu states 'Access to these files is limited to faculty and staff of Michigan State University' for the downloadable logo toolkits, but the wordmark SVG used by the page's own BrandBar/footer component is publicly served and was directly fetched, so it is a genuinely official published asset.

records.title: Estonian Scholarship Programme for international students, researchers and academic staff — Scholarship for degree and exchange study in Estonia

validation.notes: The official_source_url is on harno.ee, the official domain of the Estonian Education and Youth Board (Haridus- ja Noorteamet), which the record names as the awarding body alongside the Ministry of Education and Research. The page's own navbar brand element loads the agency logo: . The site self-identifies via og:site_name 'Haridus- ja Noorteamet'. Fetched the SVG successfully: vector artwork, viewBox 0 0 55 11, brand colours #003087 and #005BBB with the #FFD500 accent of the agency mark. Two caveats kept at MEDIUM rather than HIGH: (a) this is the agency's institutional mark, not a mark specific to the Estonian Scholarship Programme - no programme-specific logo exists on this domain (the page contains no other logo file), and (b) the SVG's intrinsic size is 55x11 px, so it renders very small unless scaled; it is vector, not a low-resolution raster, and the header sizes it with 'mh-100 mw-100'.

records.title: Scholarship Program for Studying at Universities in Kazakhstan (Bolashak / Center for International Programs)

validation.notes: The official_source_url is on bolashak.gov.kz, the official domain of JSC 'Center for International Programs' (Bolashak), and the page states the operator verbatim: 'The operator of the Scholarship Program is JSC "Center for International Programs".' The site logo is /storage/app/media/logo.svg, used in both the header (<a class="logo">) and the footer (<a class="logofoot">), but that file is a white-on-transparent knockout (all paths fill:#fff, .cls-1 { fill: #fff; }) built for the dark site header, so it renders blank on a light card. The full-colour official mark of the same logo system - navy 'BOLASHAK' wordmark over the light-blue 'Center for International Programs' lockup with the blue/white emblem - is published on the same official domain as /storage/app/media/logoog.jpg and is the logo image the official page itself declares. Fetched and visually inspected: it is a clean logo lockup on a plain white field, no share-card furniture, no people, no badge. Kept at MEDIUM only because this particular file is the page's og:image declaration; the artwork itself is the genuine official brand mark. No favicon, no UI icon, no third-party mirror, no decorative hero art.
